OBJECT Codeunit 50010 Local Suffix
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    PROCEDURE ComputeTotal@1(FactorP@1000 : Decimal) Result : Decimal;
    VAR
      CounterL@1001 : Integer;
      AlreadyHasL@1002 : Decimal;
      VeryLongLocalVariableName30Chr@1003 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      // CAL010: Counter -> CounterL; AlreadyHasL stays; Result (return var) stays without L
      // CAL010: VeryLongLocalVariableName30Chr exceeds 30 chars with 'L' -> warning only, not renamed
      CounterL := 10;
      AlreadyHasL := CounterL * FactorP;
      VeryLongLocalVariableName30Chr := CounterL;
      Result := AlreadyHasL + VeryLongLocalVariableName30Chr;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
